name: Docling VLM Pipeline
mechanism: Renders pages for a vision-language model and converts visual document understanding into structured Docling output, optionally retaining native text signals.
use_when: Layouts, diagrams, formulas or degraded scans defeat deterministic parsing
avoid_when: GPU capacity or latency budget is tight
Unsupported generated structure cannot be independently checked
expected_effects: Better recovery on visually difficult pages
Unified structured output across visual layouts
failure_modes: Plausible but unsupported text or structure
GPU memory exhaustion on large pages
required_evals: GPU latency and memory by page class
